requirements.quote: Add `packages/db/src/schema/drafting.ts` (tables `template` with nullable workspace_id for system templates and a SELECT-only policy for members, `draft`, `draft_version` immutable with content_sha256)
the generated timestamped migration under `packages/db/migrations` with snapshot, schema barrel export

`packages/validators/src/drafting.ts` (`TemplateSchema`, `BlockSchema` with unknown block type / slot without resolver / narrative without length cap rejected with field-level errors, `DraftSchema`, `FormatPresetSchema`, `ExportRequestSchema`) and its barrel export.
Register in `packages/db/src/index.test.ts`, the RLS catalog in `packages/db/src/__tests__/rls/sql.test.ts`, TABLE_TESTS/registry and two-tenant seeders.
Acceptance: tables exist with workspace_id not null (except system templates), RLS enabled and forced keyed on app.workspace_id; invalid trees rejected; typecheck strict.

deliverables.change: Define `template` via globalOrWorkspaceTable (id, code, name, kind, court preset key, blocks jsonb, locale, version int, enabled, timestamps; unique (workspace_id, code) nullsNotDistinct like forum_scope_code_uq), `draft` via tenantTable (id, template_id single-column FK restrict, optional matter_id composite FK (workspace_id, matter_id) to matter, title, status text + check, created_by user FK, timestamps; unique (workspace_id, id)), `draft_version` via tenantTable (id, draft_id composite FK (workspace_id, draft_id), version_no int unique per draft, content jsonb, content_sha256 text with check ^[0-9a-f]{64}$, created_by, created_at only).

Generate with `pnpm --filter @causedeck/db db:generate`, rename to the next free timestamp after 20261025040000 if needed, then hand-add: tenantPolicy SQL (ENABLE+FORCE RLS, ws_isolation) for draft and draft_version; globalOrWorkspacePolicy SQL for template (ws_isolation, global_read, owner_catalogue); scopeGuardTrigger for draft.template_id -> template; BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE immutability trigger on draft_version with REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION FROM PUBLIC and GRANT to causedeck_app; table GRANTs to causedeck_app; header comments like 20261025030000_whatsapp_link.sql. Expand-only.
Journal entry idx 99 for the new migration (generated)
Add 'template', 'draft', 'draft_version' to the root table list (alphabetical)

Add draft and draft_version to the tenant catalog list, template to the global-or-workspace list and to the ws_isolation/global_read/owner_catalogue policy test; add tests that a member of B can SELECT a system template but cannot INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE one, and that draft_version UPDATE/DELETE is rejected
Add template, draft, draft_version: DB_TABLES_TEST to TABLE_TESTS
Two-tenant seeders for template (workspace-owned row), draft (with its template) and draft_version (with its draft, valid 64-hex content_sha256)

zod: closed lists BLOCK_TYPES, SLOT_RESOLVERS, COURT_PRESETS, EXPORT_FORMATS (docx, pdf); recursive BlockSchema (z.lazy, discriminated by type; unknown type rejected; slot requires a resolver in SLOT_RESOLVERS; narrative requires integer maxChars 1..N; section/list carry children); TemplateSchema (blocks array, bounded depth/count), FormatPresetSchema (page size, margins, font, line spacing, numbering), DraftSchema, draft version content shape with sha256 hex, ExportRequestSchema (draftVersionId uuid, format). Issues carry field paths.
Tests: valid tree passes; unknown block type, slot without/with unknown resolver, narrative without cap, nested bad block each rejected with the expected issue path
Add subpath export "./drafting": "./src/drafting.ts" (alphabetical, matching the existing subpath exports)

preserve.what: Existing global-or-workspace tables forum/court_hall/bench and their policies (packages/db/src/schema/court.ts, packages/db/src/rls-policies.ts) are unchanged
Existing migrations and snapshots are not edited; only a new migration is appended after 20261025040000_whatsapp_inbound
Existing exports of @causedeck/validators (packages/validators/src/index.ts) and the @causedeck/db schema barrel stay unchanged; packages/db gains no dependency on @causedeck/validators

validate.command: pnpm --filter @causedeck/validators exec vitest run src/drafting.test.ts src/index.test.ts
pnpm --filter @causedeck/db exec vitest run src/index.test.ts src/__tests__/rls/sql.test.ts
pnpm --filter @causedeck/db exec tsx scripts/check-schema-conventions.ts && pnpm --filter @causedeck/db exec tsx scripts/lint-migrations.ts && pnpm --filter @causedeck/db exec drizzle-kit check

decisions.choice: template uses globalOrWorkspaceTable + globalOrWorkspacePolicy rather than a bespoke SELECT-only policy
decisions.justification: Gives members SELECT on system rows (global_read) and owner-only writes; precedent forum at packages/db/src/schema/court.ts:26 and rls-policies.ts:91; the table must be listed at conventions.ts:102

decisions.choice: draft_version immutability via BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE trigger copied from saas_invoice
Closed block/resolver/preset lists live in packages/validators; db stores jsonb without importing validators
decisions.justification: Avoids a new db->validators workspace dependency (P3); #767 and #768 import validators for parsing
